subject: general
question: The distance covered (in km) by a bus in 55 minutes at a speed of 69 km/h is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the bus = 69 km/h.

Time = 55 minutes = 55/60 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

First, convert time into hours,

Time = 55/60 hours = 11/12 hours

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = 69 × (11/12)

Distance = 63.25 km

**The distance covered by the bus in 55 minutes at a speed of 69 km/h is 63.25 km.**
